key_insight: Graph neural networks are most useful when relational structure adds value, but their benefits depend strongly on the domain, graph construction, and the architecture’s limits.
clinical_relevance: For healthcare and biomedical NLP, graph models may help integrate relationships in data, but reported gains should be checked against strong baselines, real-world deployment needs, and robustness concerns.
method: Surveyed graph neural network methods across a unified design space.
Connected spectral and spatial formulations and their expressive power to the Weisfeiler-Leman hierarchy.
Compared 12 application domains using graph construction choices, dominant architectures, and reported limitations.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a cross-domain survey that evaluates 12 domains and explicitly distinguishes reported gains from artefacts of weak baselines or favourable splits.
watch_item: Temporal graphs, heterophily, and distribution shift remain major challenges, so leaderboard performance may not translate into reliable deployment.
paper_title: Graph Neural Networks Applications Across Domains: All Insights You Need
